snippet.title: Petrichor Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Petrichor on Steam!!
store.steampowered.com/app/4168440/Petrichor/

Petrichor is a JRPG about a space cub going on a quest to find the perfect houseplant. Make friends, defeat monsters, help people, save the stars and maybe get his plant. Maybe.

As he wakes up, Jobert finds himself in a bit of a pickle: earthquakes and monsters are ravaging his home planetoid. And it smells weird! Determined to find a suitable houseplant and help everyone out of obligation, he embarks on journey that will take him across the cosmos - from the sprawling Asteroid City to the Space Carnival, Jobert will make friends, defeat monsters, help people, save the stars and maybe get his plant. Maybe.
